verdict.rationale: Vercel Workflows is documented explicitly as durable, retryable, code-based multi-step logic that resumes across crashes/deployments without manual queue/retry wiring, running on a fully managed platform alongside Sandbox and AI Gateway for the broader agent runtime stack. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of Workflows SDK behavior beyond first-party docs, and no concrete example showing queue-free wiring in a real production deployment.
